claims.text: An image is read-only: a container gets the image's files plus a writable layer of its own; changes a container makes are not written to the image and are not visible in other containers.
claims.source_hint: Docker docs: images and containers / storage drivers (container layer)

claims.text: docker build makes an image from a Dockerfile; docker run starts a container; docker compose up (scripts/up.sh, --build) builds lab and api from their Dockerfiles, pulls db/web/app-web images, and starts a container for each service.
claims.source_hint: Docker docs: docker build, docker run, docker compose up; examples/don-hang @ stage-1 scripts/up.sh

claims.text: lab/Dockerfile is FROM lscr.io/linuxserver/openssh-server:version-10.3_p1-r1 plus RUN apk add openssl, git, postgresql17-client, procps; compose builds it as image donhang-lab:stage-0 and runs container donhang-lab.

donhang-web and donhang-app-web both run image caddy:2.10.0; web gets the Caddyfile and www/ mounted, app-web gets DonHang.App/build/web and command caddy file-server --root /srv/app --listen :8081. web forwards /api/v1/* to api:8080 (Caddyfile reverse_proxy).

With the lab running, docker ps lists five containers (donhang-lab, donhang-db, donhang-web, donhang-api, donhang-app-web); a file written with docker exec in donhang-web is not found in donhang-app-web.
claims.source_hint: generator check on the running lab (cat: can't open '/tmp/note.txt': No such file or directory)

claims.text: docker ps lists running containers by default; removing a container leaves its image, which docker images still lists.
claims.source_hint: Docker docs: docker rm, docker images

claims.text: Every learner builds the lab image from the same file on the same pinned base image, the main reason script outputs match across machines (apk packages are not pinned).
Mounted storage (caddy-data:/data, lab-config:/config, db-data) is not reset when a container is replaced; donhang-web uses network_mode service:lab and has no network address of its own.
claims.source_hint: examples/don-hang @ stage-1: docker-compose.yml volumes, web.network_mode; Docker docs: storage

claims.text: In a name such as caddy:2.10.0 the part after the colon is the tag, usually marking a version (optional, default latest); docker rm removes a container; donhang-api:stage-1 is built by compose from DonHang.Api/Dockerfile.
claims.source_hint: Docker docs: image tags, docker rm; examples/don-hang @ stage-1 docker-compose.yml api.build/image
